name: robots/enactic__openarm_maniskill_simulation
title: OpenArm PickCube-v1 (ManiSkill/SAPIEN)
intro: OpenArm PickCube-v1 (ManiSkill/SAPIEN), adapted from enactic/openarm_maniskill_simulation. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 3 more; runs `reset`, `step` and `seed`. `reset`: reset the simulated world to a scenario start state and return the initial observation. When a seed is supplied the endpoint records it in the receipt; otherwise the endpoint's declared default seed applies. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
